parameters.M: Squarefree product of k distinct odd primes; M=1 allowed
parameters.predicate: Pure QR conjunction including zero; no extra x-unit filter

manually_verified_derivations.result: |tau|^2=p, so universal chi(z) Gauss expansion including z=0 is legitimate.
B_p(h)=Σ_(u≠0)e_p(−Nu−h²/(4u)); χ(u)^2=1 and same tau cancels, no χ(−1) phase.
p>2, p∤N, h≠0 imply A=−N and B=−h²/4 are nonzero. h=0 handled separately as exact −1.
I_p=(1+chi(x²−N)+1_(x²=N))/2; root term contributes at most2. H_p(0)=a_p=(p+chi(N))/2≥1.
H_M(h)=∏H_p(h·(M/p)^−1 modp); frequency vanishes iff p|h; retain exact local means there.
d=M/gcd(h,M); frequencies exactly h=(M/d)b with gcd(b,d)=1; |H_M(h)|≤S5^omega(d)/√d.
|C_L(c)−δL|≤δ6^k√M(1+logM); no unproved conversion of full-period density into prefix density.
M>1: two real groups E≥SP+SQ≥2√S; one real/one virtual group E≥S≥√S. M1: E may0 but C_L=L.
For M≤L², k≤K2(L). D≤L/2 gives C≥δL/2; D>L/2 gives λ√S, and √(2(K+2))≤K+2 retains common finite Phi.
For M>L² take shortest sorted prime-prefix R_j>L². Its preceding prefix≤L² gives j≤K+1; Sj>L²/[2^K(K+3)], and all other a_p≥1 ensure S≥Sj. No false bound on total k.
Phi(1)=2; M1 uses W≥mu, M>1 uses at least one real nonempty group W≥lambda.

remaining_scope_gap: Other compressed/adaptive/amortized structures, rank-only or early-stop uses, additional filters, batched inspection, prime powers/even primes and general factoring complexity are not covered.
